targeted_tls_diagnostic_test.scope: offline fixture-only classification; it verifies host-and-port-only text and no automatic full-text retry statement

release_xcode_build.command: xcodebuild -project LatticeLens.xcodeproj -scheme LatticeLens -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=macOS -jobs 1 ARCHS=arm64+x86_64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO DEBUG_INFORMATION_FORMAT=dwarf-with-dsym SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=YES build

mounted_dmg_inspection.scope: read-only mounted DMG; ad-hoc signature, version/build, and both executable architectures verified; no app launch or network request

live_provider_tls.scope: no real endpoint, Keychain credential, Application Support library, paper text, or LLM request was accessed

release_status.tls_handling: TLS trust and negotiation failures are classified without path, credential, prompt, or response disclosure. The app does not retry or downgrade transport; normal macOS certificate validation and HTTPS-only policy remain enforced.
release_status.manual_receipt_rebinding: required before final seal for this exact DMG and installed executable
release_status.install_boundary: This manifest does not authorize overwriting /Applications. Replacement requires the user to quit the running app and confirm the staged bundle.
